title: Local Broadcast of calibation from AAPS aren't  registered in calibation data table or graph.
symptom: When using the calibration feature of AAPS, the toast notification 'Calibration sent to Xdrip+' appears in AAPS and a 'jamorham nsreceiver' event log says 'Processing broadcasted calibation: X.XX offset ms: YY' in Xdrip+ log, but the calibration is not taken into account as it is not visible in Calibration Data table or Calibration graph. No other event related to the calibration is visible in the log after that. Out of about 20 attempts, it worked normally only 2 times, but the reason for those successes is unknown.
evidence_quote: When using the calibation feature of AAPS, I get the toast notification "Calibration sent to Xdrip+" in AAPS and I can see a 'jamorham nsreceiver' event log saying "Processing broadcasted calibation: X.XX offset ms: YY" in Xdrip+ log, but the calibation isn't taken into account as it is not visible in Calibation Data table or Calibation graph.
